stories.headline: 4.3 Million AI Repositories on GitHub Mark 178 Percent Year-Over-Year Growth
stories.excerpt: GitHub's annual report reveals AI-related repositories grew 178 percent year-over-year, now exceeding 4.3 million LLM-focused projects. The surge reflects both enterprise adoption and individual developer experimentation with open-source models, agents, and fine-tuning frameworks.
stories.licenceBasis: Hacker News public API — titles and links, discussion linked out

stories.headline: Artemis II Crew Captures First Human-Taken Photographs of Lunar Far Side in Half a Century
stories.excerpt: The four-person Artemis II crew transmitted the first photographs taken by human eyes of the lunar far side since the Apollo era, as their Orion spacecraft completed its closest approach to the Moon at roughly 130 kilometers altitude. Mission controllers report all spacecraft systems performing nominally through the gravity assist maneuver.

stories.headline: US Economic Activity Expands at Solid Pace Despite Elevated Uncertainty, Fed Says
stories.excerpt: Federal Reserve officials characterized economic activity as expanding at a solid pace in their latest assessment, despite elevated uncertainty owing in part to the conflict in the Middle East. The committee noted softer hiring alongside sticky services inflation as reasons for maintaining the current rate stance.
stories.licenceBasis: Federal Reserve public domain — official minutes and statements

stories.headline: Pharmaceutical Giant Novo Nordisk Hit by Cyberattack Targeting Research Data
stories.excerpt: Danish pharmaceutical company Novo Nordisk, maker of the blockbuster weight-loss drug Ozempic, disclosed a cyberattack that targeted research and development databases. The company said patient-facing services were not affected, but confirmed that proprietary drug development data may have been accessed by the attackers.

stories.headline: AI-Generated Deepfake Identities Used to Bypass KYC Checks at Major Financial Institutions
stories.excerpt: Cybercriminals are using sophisticated AI-generated deepfake identities to bypass know-your-customer verification checks at major financial institutions. The synthetic identity documents and video verification footage are realistic enough to defeat automated screening systems, prompting calls for next-generation biometric authentication standards.
stories.licenceBasis: AI synthesis from NVD and financial security reports

stories.headline: Webb Telescope Reveals Unexpectedly Massive Galaxies From Universe's First 500 Million Years
stories.excerpt: New James Webb Space Telescope observations revealed galaxies far more massive than expected from the universe's first 500 million years, challenging current models of early galaxy formation. The findings suggest star formation in the early universe was significantly more efficient than previously understood.

stories.headline: Solar Now Produces 58% of All New Electricity Generation Capacity Added Globally
stories.excerpt: Solar photovoltaic installations now account for 58% of all new electricity generation capacity added worldwide, outpacing wind, gas, and all other sources combined. The dominance is driven by rapidly falling panel costs, streamlined permitting in key markets, and massive manufacturing scale-up in China and Southeast Asia.
stories.licenceBasis: AI synthesis from RMI and IEA capacity data
